diagnoses.label: hardcoded repo path and patch contract
diagnoses.observable_evidence: In maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md, the artifact contract and diagnostic sequence hardcode /home/travis/build/failed/google/auto and patch path /home/travis/build/failed/google/auto/patch_1.diff, while the task states the repository is at /home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id> and patch files must be written under that dynamic path.
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Any step that instructs where to cd, where to write failed_reasons.txt, and where to write/apply patch_{i}.diff for arbitrary <repo>/<id> trials
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Trials that explicitly fix the repository path to a single known constant (e.g., a one-off benchmark that always uses google/auto)
diagnoses.target_section: Build-repair artifact contract; Minimal diagnostic sequence
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Replace hardcoded repository-specific paths with placeholders/variables aligned to the task contract (e.g., $REPO_DIR=/home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id>) and ensure all subsequent commands and patch paths reference that bound target.

diagnoses.label: missing guidance for nested invoker test project dependency scope
diagnoses.observable_evidence: maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md emphasizes running the full reactor including Maven Invoker integration tests, but provides no mechanism for diagnosing/fixing dependency resolution failures inside nested invoker test projects (their own pom.xml) versus the main reactor POMs; the location hint explicitly flags “嵌套测试项目的依赖解析与修改范围”.
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Invoker/nested test project dependency resolution triage
diagnoses.scope_boundary: Maven builds that use maven-invoker-plugin (or similar) to run integration tests against nested sample projects under src/it, it/, or similar directories, where failures arise from those nested projects’ dependency/plugin resolution
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Single-module or multi-module builds without invoker-style nested projects (where all dependencies are resolved from the main reactor only)
diagnoses.target_section: General Maven lifecycle reminders / guidance around Invoker integration tests
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Add a decision procedure to locate invoker test projects, inspect their pom.xml and settings inheritance, run dependency:tree/effective-pom within the nested project context, and constrain edits to the correct POM (nested vs parent) based on where resolution actually fails.

diagnoses.label: ambiguous modification boundary between parent reactor and nested test projects
diagnoses.observable_evidence: maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md instructs to ensure the full reactor including invoker tests succeeds, but does not define a safe modification boundary (what to change in parent vs nested test projects) and warns against modernizing JDK symptoms; without boundary rules, repairs may be misapplied (e.g., changing parent dependencyManagement when only nested IT project needs a repository/dependency tweak).
diagnoses.mechanism_anchor: Change-scope isolation for multi-context Maven builds
diagnoses.scope_boundary: When the build includes multiple Maven contexts (root reactor + nested invoker projects) and a failure could be fixed in more than one place
diagnoses.do_not_generalize_to: Failures that are clearly confined to a single module within the main reactor (no secondary Maven execution contexts)
diagnoses.target_section: Core rule / Do not modernize / Artifact contract (where it discusses what to patch)
diagnoses.recommended_direction: Strengthen guidance to (a) confirm which Maven execution context fails, (b) prefer the minimal, most local fix in the failing context, and (c) avoid broad parent-level dependencyManagement/plugin changes unless the failure is proven to originate there.

overlay.composition_issue: Hardcoded paths misbind the working directory and patch artifact locations, which then prevents the later invoker/nested-project triage mechanism from being applied to the correct filesystem targets; additionally, missing/weak nested-project scope rules increase the chance of applying fixes in the wrong POM even if the correct repo path is used.
preservation_constraints: Preserve the guidance about reproducing CI under the declared historical JDK before patching
Preserve the requirement to run the exact CI Maven command (including -f build-pom.xml when applicable) and to ensure invoker integration tests pass
Preserve the warnings against modernizing away historical-JDK symptoms

package_assessment.rationale: All observed defects are localized to documentation mechanisms in maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md (path binding and missing invoker nested-project dependency triage/scope rules) and can be corrected by editing that file without needing external context or changes to other skills.
